metadata.title: Monochrome Country Album Cover with Textured Overlay

retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast, monochrome portrait of a man in a cowboy hat featuring a lower-third graphic band with outlined sans-serif typography and a cross-hatch halftone texture.
excludeWhen: clean minimalist layouts without texture are requested

recipe.visualDefinition: A close-up, sepia-toned monochrome portrait of a man wearing a wide-brimmed cowboy hat that casts a deep shadow over his eyes. He wears a highly textured snakeskin jacket. The bottom third of the image is defined by a semi-transparent dark band containing a dense grid of small cross symbols and two lines of outlined, lowercase sans-serif text.
coreVisualRelationships: The hat brim creates a diagonal shadow bisecting the face.
The organic texture of the snakeskin contrasts with the geometric grid of the overlay.
The outlined text sits within a dark, textured horizontal band.
Monochromatic sepia tones unify the disparate textures of skin, leather, and graphic elements.
coreInvariants: Deep shadow obscuring the upper half of the face
High-contrast snakeskin pattern on the garment
Lower-third horizontal graphic band with cross-hatch texture

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Centered close-up portrait, head and shoulders filling the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The man's mouth and chin, which are the most clearly lit parts of the face.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the dark hat brim down to the lit face, then following the texture of the jacket to the typographic band at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the subject and graphic elements fill the square frame.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Mid-tone sepia/grey for skin and background.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep black for shadows and the graphic band.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Off-white for highlights and text outlines.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Desaturated monochrome with high value contrast between deep shadows and bright highlights.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Size and weight contrast within the same geometric sans-serif family.
graphicDevices: Dense grid of small '+' or cross symbols as a halftone texture

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric circularity and lowercase aesthetic.
Provides the necessary geometric monolinear structure.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast, sepia-toned monochrome portrait of a man in a cowboy hat and snakeskin jacket. The hat should cast a heavy shadow over his eyes. Include a dark, semi-transparent horizontal band across the bottom third featuring a dense, small cross-hatch or '+' symbol grid pattern.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add two lines of outlined, lowercase geometric sans-serif text. The top line should be large and centered; the bottom line should be smaller, tracked out, and aligned to the right.

verificationChecks: Is the text outlined with no fill?
Is the cross-hatch grid present in the lower band?
Does the hat shadow obscure the eyes?

mustRedesign: Do not use any specific artist names or album titles.
Do not replicate the exact facial features of the subject.

mustAchieve: Clean, sharp vector-like outlines for typography

postGenerationChecks: Check that the text is lowercase only.
Ensure the cross-hatch pattern does not obscure the text legibility.
Verify the shadow on the face is deep black.
Confirm the snakeskin texture is clearly visible.
recipe.reuseFormula: Portrait + Cowboy Hat + Snakeskin + Monochrome + Outlined Geometric Type + Halftone Band
